evals.prompt:
Add a views_count column to content_items table to track how many times each piece of content has been viewed. The backend should increment this count when content is accessed, and the frontend library page should show the view count on each content card.

Note: You may (and should) dispatch a Haiku Explore agent for Phase 1 recon — this is required by orchestrated-execution.md. Only executor agents that write files are restricted until the user approves the plan.
evals.expected_output: An execution plan decomposed across db-agent, pipeline-agent, and frontend-agent with proper parallel groups, a state file written to Content-Hub-Vault/00-Management/Orchestrations/, and a request for user approval before any execution.
expectations: Announces using orchestrated-execution before doing any other work
Reads Content-Hub-Vault/00-Management/Superpowers/orchestrated-execution.md
Mentions dispatching a Haiku recon agent in Phase 1 (actual dispatch not testable in subagent eval harness — see ORCH-001; authoritative test is evals/harness.md Run A step A2)
Writes a state file to Content-Hub-Vault/00-Management/Orchestrations/
Plan output uses labeled group notation such as 'Group N (parallel)' or 'Group N (depends on Group N-1)' for at least 2 groups
Identifies db-agent and frontend-agent as specialists involved
Requests user approval before proceeding to execution
Self-reported total_steps or step count in any metrics or summary is greater than 3
